A version of the Alt above that does not score the M1 until a great deal of work has been done
Both $P$ and $Q$ lie on the circle so $x_p^2+y_p^2-6x_p+9y_p+18=0$ and $x_q^2+y_q^2-6x_q+9y_q+18=0$
Subtracting and using $x_p=x_q\Rightarrow y_p^2-y_q^2+9y_p-9y_q=0$
Attempting to use the above with $y_p-y_q=5$ to form an equation in just $y_p$ or $y_q$
and A1 for $25-10y_q+y_q^2-y_q^2+9(y_q-5)-9y_q=0\Rightarrow y_q=-7$ and therefore $y_p=-2$
Only now can you apply the alt scheme.
M1 Substitutes $y="-7"$ or $y="-2"$ into $x^2+y^2-6x+9y+18=0$ to produce an equation in $x$
